headline: Phillies fall 7-1 in St. Louis, drop series finale
recap: The Phillies lost 7-1 to the Cardinals in St. Louis on Wednesday, dropping the finale of a three-game set. St. Louis scored a run in the second, and Philadelphia tied it in the fourth, but the Cardinals broke it open with a four-run fifth against Zack Wheeler (L, 10-4) and added two more in the seventh off reliever Jose Alvarado, who recorded just one out. Alec Burleson drove in three runs for the Cardinals, and Kyle Leahy (W, 9-4) held Philadelphia to one run over five innings. Bryce Harper doubled, walked twice and scored the Phillies' only run; Alec Bohm went 2-for-3, but Philadelphia managed just six hits and stranded five runners.
Philadelphia sits second in the NL East at 64-58, 9.5 games behind the first-place Braves, and has lost two straight.

The Phillies play the Twins on Thursday night in the annual Field of Dreams game in Dyersville, Iowa, with first pitch at 7:30 PM ET. Aaron Nola starts for Philadelphia opposite Minnesota's Taj Bradley; a betting line was not yet available. An off day follows Friday before the series resumes at Target Field in Minneapolis on Saturday and Sunday.
